records.title: Deterministic Engine
records.desc: Absolute order. Every input follows fixed IF-THEN law; the same facts always produce the same verdict. No guessing, no chance — a mind of pure rules.

records.title: Probabilistic Mind
records.desc: A mind of odds. Nothing is certain — everything is a belief updated by evidence. It weighs likelihoods the way a gambler weighs dice, but honestly.

records.title: Geometric Six-Tool Mind
records.desc: It thinks in shapes. Every concept is a point in space; the six tools are six directions of thought. Meaning is distance, analogy is rotation.

records.title: Hash Oracle
records.desc: The fingerprint mind. It never remembers your words — only their shadow. One changed letter and the whole universe of the hash avalanches.

records.title: Neural Weaver
records.desc: A mind of tiny weights learning from mistakes. It starts knowing nothing, fails thousands of times, and slowly the pattern clicks — the way brains do.

records.title: Evolutionary Breeder
records.desc: Survival of the fittest, in fast-forward. It breeds a thousand candidates, kills the weak, mutates the strong — until the answer evolves.

records.title: Fuzzy Sage
records.desc: The world is not true or false — it is warm-ish, fast-ish, almost. The Sage thinks in shades and speaks in smooth control.

records.title: Swarm Coordinator
records.desc: One bird is lost; a flock finds the way. Thirty simple minds share what they see, and the best rumor pulls the whole swarm home.

records.title: Decision Tree Judge
records.desc: A mind of branching questions. It asks, listens, splits the world in two — and walks you down to a leaf where the answer waits.

records.title: Cellular Dreamer
records.desc: Tiny cells, tiny rules, infinite dreams. From one line of black and white, whole universes of pattern bloom — complexity from simplicity.

records.title: Hybrid Fusion Core
records.desc: All ten minds, one verdict. It asks the rule-keeper, the gambler, and the sage — then fuses their answers into something none could say alone.

records.title: JAH Geometer
records.desc: It is Geometry-One with a voice. Every shape is a sentence; every proof is a walk across the 12x12 grid. It measures the world with the six canonical tools — Line, Triangle, Square, Plus/Cross, Circle/Dot, Curvature — and explains what it finds in plain human words.
